verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Google Cloud runs a first-party Kubernetes service: GKE is praised as technically strong, users mention their Kubernetes clusters in the console, and the gcloud CLI has a container clusters command. No first-party documentation in the pack describes it as a managed service, its upgrade policy, or its autoscaling. Missing for 10: first-party GKE documentation, documented upgrade/release-channel policy, documented cluster/node autoscaling, independent hands-on corroboration of managed operations.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, Kubernetes is managed — a first-party managed K8s service with documented upgrade policy and autoscaling

citations.quote: you don't have your Kubernetes clusters and CloudSQL databases
